BankAccount.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initialize the instance balance field from the provided balance argument, defaulting to 0." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "The instance being initialized."
        <REF> balance </REF>: any "Initial balance value, defaulting to 0."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign the current balance argument directly to the instance attribute self.balance. RESULT self.balance]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
BankAccount.deposit:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Validate that the deposit amount is not negative, add it to the current balance, and return the updated balance." deposit]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "Object instance that holds the balance attribute to update."
        <REF> amount </REF>: number "Deposit amount to add to the current balance."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: number "The updated balance after adding the deposit amount."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Add amount to self.balance after validation passes. RESULT updated_balance]
            [COMMAND Return self.balance. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: amount is less than 0]
        [LOG "Reject the deposit because the amount is negative and therefore invalid."]
        [THROW ValueError "Raised when the deposit amount is negative with message 'Invalid amount'."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
BankAccount.withdraw:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Validate a requested withdrawal amount, reject negative or over-balance requests, subtract the amount from the current balance, and return the updated balance." withdraw]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "The current object instance that holds the balance attribute."
        <REF> amount </REF>: number "The requested withdrawal amount to validate and subtract from the current balance."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: number "The updated balance after subtracting the withdrawal amount."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether amount is less than 0 before any balance update. RESULT negative_amount_check]
            [COMMAND Check whether amount is greater than self.balance after the non-negative validation passes. RESULT insufficient_balance_check]
            [COMMAND Subtract amount from self.balance when both validation checks pass. RESULT updated_balance]
            [COMMAND Return self.balance after the subtraction. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: amount is strictly less than 0.]
        [LOG "Invalid withdrawal amount: amount is negative."]
        [THROW ValueError "Raised when the withdrawal amount is negative."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: amount is strictly greater than self.balance.]
        [LOG "Insufficient balance for withdrawal: requested amount exceeds current balance."]
        [THROW ValueError "Raised when the withdrawal amount exceeds the available balance."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
BankAccount.view_balance:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Return the current value of the instance attribute balance." view_balance]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "The instance whose balance attribute is being read."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: any "The current value stored in self.balance."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Access the instance attribute self.balance from the current object. RESULT balance_value]
            [COMMAND Return the accessed balance_value to the caller. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
BankAccount.transfer:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Transfer the requested amount by withdrawing it from the current account and then depositing the same amount into the other account." transfer]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> other_account </REF>: object "The target account object that receives the deposited amount."
        <REF> amount </REF>: number "The amount to transfer unchanged between the two account operations."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Withdraw the specified amount from the current account using self.withdraw(amount). RESULT withdrawal_applied]
            [COMMAND If the withdrawal step completes without interrupting execution, deposit the same unchanged amount into the target account using other_account.deposit(amount). RESULT deposit_applied]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
